Pastel on moderately thick, brown wove paper mounted to a thick gray cardboard
(Source: Paper Survey researched by Judith C. Walsh and published in Lynes, 1999.)

cr_data.provenance: Anita O'Keeffe (Mrs. Robert R.) Young, Newport, Rhode Island, by 1965; The artist, date unknown; Estate of the artist, 1986 (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Exam. at Amer. Place, April 1946. . . . On backing: '1941 O'Keeffe pastel' [not verified]. Note: Identified by O'Keeffe." (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.notes: Source of title: Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks, 1942 New York (An American Place) exhibition checklist.
titles.title: An Orchid

description: An extreme close-up of an orchid shows the flower's white outer petals extending beyond the scope of the composition. The inner petals are white at their tips and become yellow and green towards the center of the flower. These petals have rough, ruffled edges and add texture to the composition.
imageCaption: Courtesy of Museum of Modern Art (MoMA).
